map.防爆标志格式为「Ex + 防爆型式 + 气体类别 + 温度组别」，例如 Ex d: The explosion-proof mark format is Ex + protection type + gas group + temperature class, e.g. Ex d IIA T2. Protection type d=flameproof, e=increased safety, i=intrinsic safety, nA=non-sparking; gas group IIA (propane, MESG>0.9 mm) -> IIB (ethylene) -> IIC (hydrogen/acetylene, MESG<=0.5 mm, strictest); temperature class T1 to T6 corresponds to max surface temperature 450/300/200/135/100/85 deg C.
map.选隔爆型(d)+IIA+温度组别 T2：标志 Ex d IIA T2，T2 最高: Select flameproof (d) + IIA + T2: mark Ex d IIA T2, T2 max surface temp 300 deg C, suits zones 1/2, gas group IIA (propane, MESG>0.9 mm, lower explosivity); if changed to increased safety (e) + IIB + T4: mark Ex e IIB T4, T4 max surface temp 135 deg C, suits zone 2, IIB (ethylene, 0.5<MESG<=0.9 mm, moderate explosivity).
map.气体类别 IIA/IIB/IIC 怎么选？: How to choose gas group IIA/IIB/IIC?
map.按环境中存在气体的最大试验安全间隙 MESG 定：丙烷等 MESG>0.9mm: By the maximum experimental safe gap MESG of the gas present: propane etc. MESG>0.9 mm is IIA, ethylene etc. 0.5 to 0.9 mm is IIB, hydrogen/acetylene etc. <=0.5 mm is IIC; IIC covers IIB and IIA with the highest protection level; wrong choice severely underestimates explosion risk.
map.温度组别 T 和数字什么关系？: What is the relationship between temperature class T and the number?
map.T 后面数字越大允许表面温度越低：T1=450℃、T2=300℃、T3=200℃: The larger the number after T, the lower the allowed surface temperature: T1=450 deg C, T2=300 deg C, T3=200 deg C, T4=135 deg C, T5=100 deg C, T6=85 deg C; it must be below the gas ignition temperature, otherwise the hot surface may become an ignition source.
